sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The 📊 unique-values dropdown's own quickfilter search box highlighted only the FIRST occurrence of the typed substring inside each entry's label (e.g. typing "as" against "» alias: Southside Johnny & The Asbury Jukes at The Stone Pony" highlighted "as" in "alias" but not "As" in "Asbury"), unlike the main table's global/column filter, which always highlights every occurrence. Fixed for all three affected entry shapes — synthetic entries ("» alias:", "» comment:", etc.), plain unique-value list entries, and flag-icon (Country/Area) entries — via one shared helper.
